import math

# IFS-2 "Selected U.S. Liabilities to Foreigners" (in millions of dollars)
# Bank-reported liabilities = Official institutions liabilities reported by banks (col 3)
#  + Other foreigners liabilities reported by banks (col 9)
#  + Liabilities to non-monetary international and regional organizations (col 11)

# End of calendar year 2002
off_2002 = 335090      # col 3
other_2002 = 325764    # col 9
intl_2002 = 26692      # col 11
total_2002 = off_2002 + other_2002 + intl_2002

# End of calendar year 2012 (Dec. p)
off_2012 = 577219      # col 3
other_2012 = 1376596   # col 9
intl_2012 = 117424     # col 11
total_2012 = off_2012 + other_2012 + intl_2012

log_growth = math.log(total_2012 / total_2002)
print(round(log_growth * 100, 2))
